# DSH Status

**A native macOS menu bar companion for DeepSeek Harness.** It keeps the state of
your DSH sessions

visible at all times — how many are running, waiting for you,
finished, or stopped — and shows the d
etails in a native panel with one click.
English · 简体中文

*The panel on macOS 27.2 (dark mode). Each row is a non-idle session with its
current state and runn

on macOS 27.2 (dark mode). Each row is a non-idle session with its
current state and running time.*
## Why use it

- **Status at a glance.** The menu bar tells you whether a session needs you
without switching back

to DSH.
- **Only what matters.** The panel lists the sessions that are running, waiting
for an answe

r, finished, or stopped — not every session you have ever opened.
- **Native, not a web wrapper.** T

he app is written in Swift with AppKit and
SwiftUI, and follows the system's own materials, colors,

and typography.
- **Local by design.** The app talks only to a bridge plugin that runs on your
own m
achine. There is no account, no cloud sync, and no telemetry.
## Features
### Menu bar icon

- Idle with nothing to report: the DeepSeek whale glyph by default, or the
app's own dashed double-r

ing mark (**Settings → Menu bar icon → Idle icon**).
- Otherwise a monochrome ring whose color is th

e highest-priority item:
red (stopped) > yellow (waiting for you) > green (completed).
- Running ses

sions animate an arc around the ring. The center number can show
all tasks (default), only tasks tha

t need you, only the count matching the
ring color, or nothing.
- Transitions between states are ani

mated; Reduced Motion, Low Power Mode, and
the in-app animation switches are respected.

*The menu-bar glyph at 8×: one session running, drawn as an animated arc with
the running count in t

ar glyph at 8×: one session running, drawn as an animated arc with
the running count in the center.*
### Session panel

- A flat list of non-idle sessions, most recently changed first.
- A colored dot marks each state: b

lue running, yellow waiting for an answer,
green completed, red stopped.
- Subagent sessions are fol

ded under their parent row and expand in place.
- Click a session to open it in DeepSeek Harness.
-

When everything is idle — or the bridge is disconnected — the panel shrinks
to a single compact butt

on that opens DSH.
- Right-click the menu-bar icon for: open DSH, Do Not Disturb, Settings, Quit.
### Notifications and sounds

- A system notification when a session needs an answer, finishes, or stops;
each state can be enable

d separately. Clicking a notification opens the
session.
- Do Not Disturb silences every notificatio

n and sound while keeping the
individual preferences.
- The alert sound can be the built-in DSH chim

e, one of eight macOS system
sounds, a custom audio file (WAV, AIFF, MP3, M4A, CAF), or silent.
- Tw

o delivery modes: **play from the app** (independent volume; not muted by
Focus) or **attach the sou

nd to the system notification** (follows Focus and
the system notification volume).
### Background

- **Launch at login** (off by default, macOS 13+). Registers through the system
login items (`SMAppS

ervice`); toggle it in **Settings → Background**. If macOS
asks for approval, allow DSH Status under

**System Settings → General → Login Items**.
- **Prevent idle sleep while sessions are running** (o

ff by default). While at
least one session is running and the bridge is connected, the app keeps the

Mac awake; the screen may still turn off, and closing the lid or sleeping
manually is not blocked.
### Settings

The standard grouped settings window covers the menu-bar icon, display,
projects, notifications, sou

nds, panel material, background, and general
options (including restore-to-defaults and quit confirm

nel material, background, and general
options (including restore-to-defaults and quit confirmation).
*The settings window on macOS 27.2 (dark mode).*
## Requirements

- **macOS 13 or later.** The 0.2.0 build is Apple Silicon (arm64) only.
- **DeepSeek Harness Desktop

0.2.x** with third-party plugin support. Tested
with 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1.
- **Liquid Glass pa

nel material** requires macOS 26 or later; on older systems
the panel uses the classic frosted mater
ial or a solid fill instead.
## Install

DSH Status has two parts: the menu bar app and a bridge plugin that runs inside
DeepSeek Harness. In
stall the app first, then the plugin.
### 1. Install the app

1. Download **`DSH-Status-0.2.0.dmg`** from the
latest release.
2. Open the DMG and drag **DSH Statu

s** into `/Applications`.
3. Open the app from `/Applications`.

The 0.2.0 build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so macOS blocks the first
launch. To allow it:

- **Right-click (Control-click) the app → Open**, then confirm **Open**; or
- open **System Settings

→ Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click
**Open Anyway** next to the DSH Status entry.

If macOS instead says that the app **is damaged**, remove the quarantine flag
and open it again:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Compatibility and known limitations
| Item | Notes |

| Tested macOS | macOS 27.2 (minimum supported: macOS 13) |
| Architecture | Apple Silicon arm64 |
|

Tested DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| Panel material | Liquid Glass on macOS 26+;
frosted / solid fallback below that |
Known limitations:

- **One snapshot for all DSH windows.** When several DSH windows are open, the
app shows a single me

rged view based on the most recent state pushed by the
bridge; per-window breakdowns are not availab

le.
- **Unread counts reset when DSH restarts.** The “needs answer” bookkeeping
lives in the DSH ren

derer, so a DSH restart starts the counts from zero.
- **No automatic updates.** New versions are pu

blished on the Releases page and
must be downloaded and installed manually.
- **Not notarized.** The

app is ad-hoc signed; the first launch after
installation needs the Gatekeeper steps above.
- **Ses

sions that ended before the bridge started** are shown as completed.
- **The app interface is curren

tly in Simplified Chinese.** The documentation
is bilingual; UI localization has not shipped yet.
